gloss: real estate agent; real estate agency

definitions.gloss: real estate agent; real estate agency
definitions.explanation: A person or business that deals with the buying, selling, and renting of properties. Common casual term for real estate professionals in Japan.

examples.japanese: {不動産屋|ふどうさんや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I looked for an apartment at a real estate agency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不動産屋|ふどうさんや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many real estate agencies in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {不動産屋|ふどうさんや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I paid a brokerage fee to the real estate agent.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧ (real estate) + {屋|や} (shop/business suffix)

FORMAL ALTERNATIVES:
・⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (real estate company)
・⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (real estate dealer)
・⟦{宅地|たくち}→宅地：21589_takuchi⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (licensed real estate transaction business - official term)

LICENSING:
Real estate agents in Japan need:
・⟦{宅地|たくち}→宅地：21589_takuchi⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦{取引士|とりひきし}→取引士：noentry⟧ (real estate transaction specialist license)
・⟦{宅建|たっけん}→宅建：noentry⟧ (abbreviation for the above license/exam)

COMMON SERVICES:
・⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧ (rental properties)
・⟦{売買|ばいばい}→売買：04336_baibai⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧ (properties for sale)
・⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦{探|さが}し→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (apartment hunting)

FEES:
・⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧ (brokerage fee) - typically 1 month's rent for rentals
・⟦{礼金|れいきん}→礼金：06080_reikin⟧/⟦{敷金|しききん}→敷金：06079_shikikin⟧ (key money/security deposit) - arranged through agent

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{不動産屋|ふどうさんや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to a real estate agency)
・{不動産屋|ふどうさんや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (to look for properties at an agency)
・{不動産屋|ふどうさんや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (to go through a real estate agent)
